Dear Counsel,

I'm a real-estate investor. I saw the estate filing for Joseph L. Simmons and am sorry for the family's loss.

If your client and the family decide to sell the house on Ladywood Ct, I'd be glad to make an as-is cash offer. I can give all three heirs one simple offer, with the numbers shown; work around the family member living in the house, with a move-out date that suits him and help with clearing out belongings; time the closing to the court's letters or homestead order; and buy as-is, covering normal closing costs at a Florida title company.

To be upfront: I am an investor buying for my own account, not a licensed real estate agent, and I don't represent the estate or the heirs. I may assign my purchase contract to another buyer before closing and may receive a fee from that buyer.

If the family plans to keep or list the house, that's completely fine; if you'd prefer I not follow up, just let me know and I won't.

Sincerely,
Iyoobsa Ero
Emporium Investments · +1-773-236-7749 · iero@emporium-investments.com
